Name: Winter Gifts
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
Someone has spread gifts around the valley, can you find them?

This mod adds 5 different gifts that spawn every year on Winter 24th and 26th.

How to open gifts:
[spoiler]
You can open gifts with the shears tool.

Hold the shears and right-click on the gift to open it.
[/spoiler]
Where to find gifts:
[spoiler]
Bus Stop
Backwoods
Town
Mountain
Railroad
Forest
Secret Woods
[/spoiler]
A bell will ring when new gifts are spawned on the map 🔔
